_comment: Triage of the ledger ids that scripts/uv-index.mjs cannot resolve from prose alone. The ledger scraper reads a doc heading and a keyword; several defects were closed in a LATER round's table or fix section, and several were never server defects. status is one of: fixed (server change, name the round), superseded (a later id replaced it), client (the client made the choice, no server change), harness (the measurement rig, not the product), accepted (open by design). Only status open counts against the open backlog.

D-2.note: price-tracker redirect guard. Verified in round 2 (docs/USER_VALUE_R2.md line 55): the IKEA URL now errors naming the cat listing page instead of returning USD 39.

D-3.note: time-tracker rate carries a currency. Verified in round 2: 'EUR 90.00/h = EUR 225.00' (docs/USER_VALUE.md fix at line 318).

D-5.note: price-tracker watch_add states the no-polling contract and names watch_refresh. Verified in round 2 (pt2).

D-6.note: spreadsheet sheet_query aggregates in one call (docs/USER_VALUE.md line 301). Round 2 called it partial only because of D-10, which is itself closed.

D-7.note: time-tracker project reconciliation. Verified in round 2: 'Acme' resolved to 'Acme website' and announced.

D-8.note: invoice currency on every line amount and the missing-address note. Verified in round 2 against the generated PDF.

D-C4.note: Round 9 fix: rate_on now returns inverse_rate / inverse_meaning, ecb_quoting_convention and published_direction, which names the ECB's own direction when the pair is quoted the other way round. servers/currency/src/index.ts rate_on; test servers/currency/test/smoke.test.mjs 'D-C4: rate_on carries both directions'.

D-D2.note: docx: the server passes the value through verbatim; the client expanded 'Lucky Strike' to the stored profile name. No server change (docs/DOCX_AUDIT.md line 136).

D-E2.note: expense-tracker markup_percent is no longer Pro-gated (servers/expense-tracker/src/index.ts:706 comment); the Pro wall that produced a wrong invoice line is gone. docs/EXPENSE_AUDIT.md line 81.

D-E4.note: --allowedTools 'mcp__*' grants nothing. A CLI fact, not a server defect; every round since 3 writes a per-tool allowlist from a live tools/list because of it.

D-R8.note: recurring: forecast and schedule_upcoming exclude settled periods and list them. docs/RECURRING_AUDIT.md line 153.

D-R9.note: A fire-and-forget JSON-RPC probe races a stateful server. docs/RECURRING_AUDIT.md line 154 records it as a harness defect; part 1 uses a sequential probe.

D-R10.note: Without WebFetch in the allowlist the client dies rather than falling back. Allowlist composition, not a server behaviour.

D-R11.note: Superseded by D-R19 as one defect class (docs/USER_VALUE_R6.md line 179); D-R19 was fixed in round 6 (tool descriptions claim the trigger words) and did not recur in rounds 7 or 8.

D-R12.note: Round 5 fix: coerce decides by pattern, never by string length. servers/spreadsheet/src/csv.ts:104 via parseNumberStrict; test servers/spreadsheet/test/round5.test.mjs:63 and :88. Probed: coerce('403.00') and coerce('1,250.00') both return numbers.

D-R13.note: Round 5 fix: sheet_add_column infers 2 decimals for money columns and takes an explicit decimals argument. servers/spreadsheet/src/index.ts:574, :588; tests round5.test.mjs:107 and :124.

D-R14.note: expense_to_invoice takes target_currency + fx_rates. Fixed and verified in round 6 (docs/USER_VALUE_R6.md line 179), exercised again for real in round 8 scenario 8 (USD 383.80).

D-R17.note: ToolSearch needs the mcp__office__ prefix. A client lookup convention; nothing in the servers to change.

D-R19.note: Round-6 fix: six sheet_*/price_check/watch_add descriptions open with an imperative claiming the trigger words, under the 220-char ratchet. docs/USER_VALUE_R6.md line 284. Did not recur in round 7 (line 194) or round 8.

D-R20.note: Round-6 fix: an empty rebill set returns no fx_note and no vat_note at all, and next_step names the two usual causes. servers/expense-tracker/src/index.ts:808-830; test round6.test.mjs:89.

D-R21.note: Round-6 fix: billable defaults to true when a project is set, and the response always states the value used and where it came from. servers/expense-tracker/src/index.ts:193-196.

D-R22.note: Round-6 fix: tag grouping is free (the Pro gate is deleted) and group_by is optional, defaulting to a plain total. servers/time-tracker/src/index.ts:729, :735; scripts/validate.mjs:78-81 asserts it on both tiers.

D-R23.note: Round-6 fix: the .corrupt marker is one line of self-describing JSON with a hint, and markerQuarantinePath falls back to the raw text for pre-fix markers. jsonstore.ts:28, expense-tracker store.ts:79.

D-T2.note: find_meeting_slots now returns the least-bad near misses alongside the refusal: findNearMissSlots (servers/timezone/src/tz.ts:691) ranks by total minutes outside anyone's window and the answer prints the work_start/work_end that would make the first one fit. servers/timezone/src/index.ts:306; test tz.test.mjs:384.

D-T3.note: Closed by the D-R27 fix: a name with no email is no longer written as ATTENDEE;CN=Tom:invalid:nomail; it moves to DESCRIPTION with the reason, and only real addresses become an ATTENDEE CAL-ADDRESS. servers/timezone/src/tz.ts:817-877. Verified on the live file in round 8 scenario 7.

D-R42.note: remote-only, round 10. license_status now reports the real auth form (URL path / URL query / header) from RequestCtx.authVia; whoami reports token_arrived_via. Deployed 7d3f5812.

D-R43.note: remote-only, round 10. bundleUrl() carries /buy/bundle?tenant=<anonToken> into upgradeText next to the $39 and into license_status; verified 303 to Stripe with metadata.product bundle and the same tenant. Deployed 7d3f5812.

D-R44.note: remote-only, round 10. license_status now returns `limits` (this tool does not count usage; a call over a cap is refused with the cap named) and `guide`. Live usage counters remain per-server state in servers/*. Deployed 7d3f5812.

D-R45.note: remote-only, round 10. license_activate now leads with the /t/<key> URL form and notes that a purchase from a ?tenant= link needs nothing pasted. Deployed 7d3f5812.

D-R46.note: invoice_create rounds a fractional unit_price to minor units then multiplies: USD 418.16 vs 418.14, INV total 3 cents over the cited ECB rate. servers/invoice, out of round 10's edit scope.

D-R47.note: docx proposal_create requires scope/deliverables/timeline, so a two-paragraph request forces invented sections. servers/docx, out of round 10's edit scope.

D-R48.note: invoice business_set stores an address that names a city but no timezone, and says nothing about it; r9's D-R35 fix reads that field. servers/invoice, out of round 10's edit scope.

D-R49.note: round 10: the model wrote the business facts into the CLI's project memory directory right after the tool said not to repeat them anywhere. No server change available.

D-R50.note: whoami is an HTTP GET only, so 'what is my tier' costs one license_status per connected server. The per-endpoint half is closed in round 10; registering whoami as a tool on every endpoint is a vendored-server change.
